Yes, your rubber plant is covered by our Plant Care Guarantee as well. 🌿

- **How long:** 30 days from delivery. Leafy Plus members get 90 days on plants ordered while their membership is active.
- **What counts:** the plant dies or declines significantly despite reasonable care. That means losing more than a third of its leaves, stem or root rot, or collapse.
- **What you get:** one free replacement of the same plant, or store credit if it's out of stock.
- **How to claim:** go to "My Orders" within the guarantee window and upload at least two photos (the whole plant and a close-up). A Plant Care Specialist will review it within 2 business days. You don't need to send the plant back.

A few things to know:

- Yellowing of one or two older leaves in the first two weeks is normal transplant stress and isn't covered on its own, so try not to worry if you see that.
- Repotting into non-Leafy soil in the first 14 days isn't covered. Since your pot is cracked, it may be tempting to repot, but please hold off for now, as new plants shouldn't be repotted for 2-3 weeks anyway. If the crack worries you, we can sort that out through your damage report.
- Pests introduced after delivery, deliberate neglect, and claims made after the window aren't covered.
- Overwatering is the most common early problem, so water only when the top inch of soil is dry.

Your damaged-pot report is separate from this guarantee, so it won't use up your guarantee replacement.

If you'd like, I can still pass your cracked-pot case to our support team so they can tell you where to send the photos. Would you prefer a replacement or a refund for the pot? I'm always happy to help, and you can reach out anytime. 🌱
